name: Concert / festival
required: engineered stage barrier if assessment calls for it
first aid/medical plan and ambulance access
rules: Stage facing is solved for event-time sun, audience glare, sound-sensitive boundaries and routes; no fixed compass rule.
FOH island cannot pinch evacuation spine or accessible viewing routes; venue acoustics may require different position.
Standing area excludes stage/FOH/queues/egress; target1 person/m² is a proposal, not a certified crowd limit.
Medical tent count is a parts-list allowance; competent medical provider sets staffing, escalation and ambulance cover.
Admission stops at holding/crowd trigger; distress or surge can trigger intervention earlier.
At2000/10000 subdivide audience under competent crowd design, coordinate PA/comms and separate service banks.

special.stage_count: 1 at100/500/2000;2 conceptual distributed stages at10000, acoustics/provider review required
special.crowd_monitoring: area-specific counts + staff observation; no inference of actual live crowd from decorative actors

values_status: All dimensions/ratios/quantities/orientation in this segment are assumptions unless the shared rule supplies a scoped verified_reference

cases.N_status: assumption until staffing/crew and actual concurrent occupancy entered
cases.area_status: assumption; excludes service/queue/egress and does not set code occupant load
cases.site_area_status: rough land-search allowance only; physical layout/anchors/stages/tailgate/exit dispersal require actual area calculation
cases.additional_food_handwash: one per cooking/catering operation provisional; health authority determines quantity
cases.egress_status: NEEDS AUTHORITY REVIEW: based on declared N, not code design load; distribution/travel/downstream/clearance time unverified
cases.wheelchair_status: proposal; fixed-seat ADA table used as inclusion reference for seated cases, scope and integrated layouts need review; standing2% is an assumption
cases.chairs_counts: regular chairs + wheelchair spaces =G in primary seated cases; companion chairs are included in regular chair count
cases.power_status: illustrative listed-part loads only; food refrigeration/cooking/large audio/etc not supplied; no equipment selection approval
